studio_workflow.assignment: Production-design scale hierarchy, anchor architecture, shape language for symbolic cover, Highland keep and boardroom/mountain split
Atlas-aware geography/biome design; separate Eastern coast, Upper Valleys, Western dry range and Southern Wetlands
Character-specific morphology and weather-light interaction; verify Niño human elemental, DK centaur, spotted Red and three heads
Costume continuity from approved Oct 18 image delta; fabric wetness and period materials without redesign
Express physical emotional intentions through gaze/weight/gesture; distinct POVs, no declared game outcome
Grounded contact points and action axes; swords/axes/clubs/tack must respect anatomy and set safety
Readable silhouette and separate emotion at phone scale; confirm no species morphing
Lens height, frame depth and decisive still moment on every folio; no repetitive generic hero-pose
Two-location composite seam, lighting/plate passes, exact source-bound render inputs, deterministic typography pipeline
Color and exposure management; atmosphere/light continuity WITHOUT imposing identical storms in each region
Seven-page editorial sequence and visual rhythm; action direction and story-pacing escalates to final survival stakes
Sound-implied visual cues: water roar, cloth flutter, axe impact risk, gravel scrape, horse tack, marsh sucking; no audio generation
